description: Experimental: the BEAT LOOP button labelled 16 sets a 32-beat loop; its label still reads 16. The application reports version 0.11, so the official v1.15 update restores stock. For staged hardware testing (docs/xdj700-flashing.md, stage 5).
label: Ver1.16

replacements.purpose: The last entry of the six-entry table that maps the PERFORM screen's BEAT LOOP buttons to the player's list of loop lengths. It selects the list's 16-beat entry; the replacement selects the next entry, 32 beats, which the list already holds. Only the BEAT LOOP touch handler, a PERFORM-screen callback, reads the table, so the change acts when the button is touched, never during start-up. The button keeps its 16 label.
